senses.zh_definition: Jilla：可指一部于 2014 年上映的泰米尔语电影的片名；这是有来源支持的专名用法，但输入词元是否指该电影尚无法确定。
senses.en_definition: An attested title of a Tamil-language film released in 2014; whether the supplied token refers to that film is unresolved.
senses.ms_definition: Judul sebuah filem bahasa Tamil yang ditayangkan pada tahun 2014; belum dapat dipastikan sama ada token dalam input merujuk kepada filem tersebut.
senses.nuances: 本条说明一种有据可查的专名用法，不是 DBP 官方马来语词义。电影资料见 [Cinema Online Malaysia](https://cinema.com.my/movies/details.aspx?search=2014.9329.jilla.17917)。下列例句均以该片名为前提，不代表已确定输入语料的指称；搭配未经频率验证，排名仅沿用输入。

etymology.historical_story: Jilla illustrates how a multilingual media corpus can contain titles alongside ordinary vocabulary. Malaysian cinema records identify a Tamil film with this title released in 2014. That evidence supports a specific cultural referent, but does not establish a Malay common noun, a Malay etymology, or the identity of the uncontextualized token supplied here. [Source](https://cinema.com.my/movies/details.aspx?search=2014.9329.jilla.17917).
